Name: Fish Nibbling Indicator
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
[size=5][u][b]Overview[/b][/u][/size]

By default, this mod just makes the exclamation mark when a fish starts nibbling easier to see.

You can edit the config to choose any graphic you want of any scale you want.


[size=5][u][b]Config[/b][/u][/size]

The config has an entry for the texture path and entries for the source rectangle in the target texture file.

The config has scale and offset entries to change the size and position of the indicator.

The config has entries for motion, alpha fade, and scale change that affect how the indicator moves and fades out.


[size=5][u][b]Technical[/b][/u][/size]

Requires SMAPI.

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Translations should use config variable names as the keys, adding .Desc to the end of the key for hover descriptions.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
